title: Administrative Rules on Individual's Foreign Exchange (PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3)
quote: Art. 9 An individual's foreign exchange sales and domestic individual's foreign exchange purchases shall be imposed an annual limit... beyond the annual limit, an individual can conduct a current account business with a commercial bank by presenting valid identity documents and relevant materials proving the transaction amount. Art. 7 ... must not evade limit administration by splitting large amount into small batches. Art. 13 A non-domestic individual can convert legitimate renminbi income obtained in China under the current account into foreign exchange and remit abroad at a bank by showing valid identity documents and relevant documents.
establishes: Annual limit applies to RMB sale and to a DOMESTIC individual's purchase; current-account business above the limit is allowed on documents. Splitting is prohibited. Non-domestic individuals convert lawful current-account RMB income on documents.

title: Regulations of the PRC on Foreign Exchange Administration (State Council Decree No. 532)
quote: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。 第十二条 经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础。 第三十九条 逃汇…处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。 第四十条 非法套汇…处非法套汇金额30%以下的罚款。 第四十二条 违反规定携带外汇出入境…可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。 第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇…处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。 第五十二条（二）境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人。
establishes: Current international payments and transfers are not restricted; current-account FX needs a genuine lawful basis. Penalty ceilings: 30% of amount for evasion/illegal arbitrage/unlawful FX trading (above 30% if serious, up to the amount), 20% for unlawful cash carriage. A foreign national continuously resident in China for 1 year or more is a DOMESTIC individual.

title: Implementation Rules of the Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (Hui Fa [2007] No. 1, as amended)
quote: 第二条 对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。 第十二条 境内个人经常项目项下非经营性购汇超过年度总额的，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料在银行办理。 第十三条（一）在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。 第十四条 外汇储蓄账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含5万美元）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理。 第二十条 移居境外的境内个人…对外转移，按《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》办理。 第三十条 个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，可以在银行直接办理。
establishes: USD 50,000/year per person applies to RMB sale and to a DOMESTIC individual's purchase. Above the aggregate, documents prove the transaction amount. Non-domestic individuals converting lawful RMB income must produce documents INCLUDING TAX VOUCHERS. FX remittance from a savings account over USD 50,000 cumulative per day needs authenticity documents. Cash withdrawal above USD 10,000/day needs prior SAFE filing.

title: Provisional Measures for the Administration of Sale and Payment of Foreign Exchange for Individuals' Outward Asset Transfers (PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16)
quote: 第二条 移民转移是指从中国内地移居外国…将其在取得移民身份之前在境内拥有的合法财产变现，通过外汇指定银行购汇和汇出境外的行为。 第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出。首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满一年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半；自首次汇出满两年后，可汇出全部剩余财产。全部申请转移财产在等值人民币20万元以下（含20万元）的，经批准后可一次性汇出。 第八条（四）移居外国的，应当提供公安机关出具的中国户籍注销证明和中国驻外使领馆出具或认证的申请人在国外定居证明。（六）…税收证明或完税凭证。 第十条 申请财产对外转移总金额在等值人民币50万元以下（含50万元）的，由所在地外汇局审批…超过上述金额的…报国家外汇管理局审批。 第十一条 外汇指定银行办理售汇后，应直接将外汇汇往…申请人本人的账户，不得在境内提取外币现钞。
establishes: The emigration-asset route has NO USD 50,000 annual cap: it is a one-time application for the whole amount, released in up to three stages (max 50% first, then 25%, balance after 2 years; amounts under RMB 200,000 may be released at once after approval). Requires cancelled PRC household registration, proof of foreign residence, and a PRC tax certificate. Approval: local SAFE under RMB 500,000; SAFE head office above. Proceeds must be wired directly to the applicant's own overseas account, never taken out as cash.

title: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 revision)
quote: 第一条 在中国境内有住所，或者无住所而一个纳税年度内在中国境内居住累计满一百八十三天的个人，为居民个人…非居民个人从中国境内取得的所得，依照本法规定缴纳个人所得税。 第三条（一）综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率（三）利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。 第七条 居民个人从中国境外取得的所得，可以从其应纳税额中抵免已在境外缴纳的个人所得税税额。 第十条（五）因移居境外注销中国户籍 [应当依法办理纳税申报]。 第十三条 纳税人因移居境外注销中国户籍的，应当在注销中国户籍前办理税款清算。
establishes: PRC tax rates on the income behind the balance: 3%-45% progressive for comprehensive income (salary, labour, author's, royalties), flat 20% for interest/dividends/property rental/property transfer/incidental. Cancelling PRC household registration to emigrate triggers a tax return and a tax settlement BEFORE deregistration. China grants a credit for foreign tax, capped.

title: Implementing Regulations of the Individual Income Tax Law
quote: 第二条 在中国境内有住所，是指因户籍、家庭、经济利益关系而在中国境内习惯性居住。 第四条 在中国境内无住所的个人…连续不满六年的…其来源于中国境外且由境外单位或者个人支付的所得，免予缴纳个人所得税。 第六条（八）财产转让所得，是指个人转让有价证券、股权…不动产…取得的所得。 第三十二条 所得为人民币以外货币的，按照办理纳税申报…上一月最后一日人民币汇率中间价，折合成人民币计算应纳税所得额。
establishes: 'Domicile' in China turns on household registration, family and economic ties. A non-domiciled individual resident under 183 days/6-year rules is taxed only on China-source income. Selling a house inside China is a property transfer (20%). Foreign-currency income is translated at the PBoC central parity of the last day of the month before filing.

publisher: PBOC (Yin Fa [2014] No. 188), via SAFE Hubei
title: Notice on Interbank FX Market Trading Rates and Bank Quoted Rates
quote: 四、每日银行间即期外汇市场人民币对美元的交易价可在中国外汇交易中心对外公布的当日人民币对美元汇率中间价上下2%的幅度内浮动。 五、银行可基于市场需求和定价能力对客户自主挂牌人民币对各种货币汇价，现汇、现钞挂牌买卖价没有限制，根据市场供求自主定价。 六、本通知自发布之日起施行。《…》（银发[2005]183号）、《…》（银发[2005]250号）、《…》（银发[2010]325号）同时废止。
establishes: Interbank USD/CNY may trade within +/-2% of the central parity. Crucially, banks quote customers FREELY: there is NO regulatory limit on a bank's spot or cash buy/sell spread to a customer. This notice repealed the three earlier notices that had imposed a spread cap. A retail FX spread therefore has no published ceiling and cannot be computed from any official figure.

publisher: SAFE and General Administration of Customs
title: Provisional Measures on Carrying Foreign Currency Cash Across the Border (Hui Fa [2003] No. 102)
quote: 出境人员携带不超过等值5000美元（含5000美元）的外币现钞出境的，无须申领《携带证》，海关予以放行；出境人员携带外币现钞金额在等值5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，应向外汇指定银行申领《携带证》，海关凭加盖外汇指定银行印章的《携带证》验放；出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元的外币现钞出境。
establishes: Carrying cash out: up to USD 5,000 no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 needs a bank-issued carrying certificate; above USD 10,000 is in principle not permitted. This makes cash carriage unusable for large balances without an exceptional SAFE permit.

title: Notice on Regulating Large Overseas Cash Withdrawals with Bank Cards (Hui Fa [2017] No. 29)
quote: 一、个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。超过年度额度的，本年及次年将被暂停持境内银行卡在境外提取现金。 四、个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金…每卡每日不得超过等值1000美元调整为等值1万元人民币。
establishes: A hard ceiling on the card/ATM channel: RMB 100,000 equivalent per natural year across all of a person's cards, and RMB 10,000 equivalent per card per day. Exceeding it suspends overseas cash withdrawal for the current and the following year.

title: Notice on Further Preventing and Handling Risks Related to Virtual Currency and RWA Tokenisation (Yin Fa [2026] No. 42)
quote: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务…一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。…金融机构（含非银行支付机构）不得为虚拟货币相关业务活动提供账户开立、资金划转和清算结算等服务…本通知自发布之日起施行。…《…》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。
establishes: Converting RMB to crypto is an illegal financial activity in China, and banks/payment institutions may not service it. This 2026 notice supersedes and expressly REPEALS the 2021 notice (Yin Fa [2021] No. 237) that earlier material still cites.

title: 2026 FX administration online information - individual FX (10): reconversion of unused RMB
quote: 境外个人可以将原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇吗？答：可以。根据《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第六十条规定，境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）…可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
establishes: Reconversion of previously exchanged unused RMB back to FX is limited: only with the original exchange memo, valid for 24 months from the exchange date. The USD 500/day ID-only allowance applies to this reconversion case, not to a general transfer of a RMB deposit.

title: Current Account Frequently Asked Questions (official FAQ booklet, PDF)
quote: 1.境内个人购汇的限额是多少…答：对境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理，年度总额为每人每年等值5万美元。 4.境外个人超出5万美元额度结汇怎么办理？答：境外个人经常项目项下非经营性结汇超过年度总额的，凭本人有效身份证件及以下证明材料在银行办理… 5.境外个人购汇怎么办理？答：（一）在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。
establishes: The USD 50,000 aggregate is described as applying to a DOMESTIC individual's purchase. For a NON-DOMESTIC individual the operative rule is documented purchase of lawful China RMB income (with tax vouchers), which the FAQ does not cap at USD 50,000. The two categories must not be conflated.

title: SAFE issues the Current Account Foreign Exchange Business Guideline (2020 edition), Hui Fa [2020] No. 14 - policy release
quote: 《指引》按照简洁清晰、便利使用的原则，全面整合经常项目外汇业务现有法规，精简部分业务流程和办理业务所需材料，同步废止法规29件…《指引》不涉及现有政策实质改动和重大调整。
establishes: The 2020 Guideline consolidates current-account FX rules and repealed 29 instruments, with no substantive policy change. It is the operative consolidated text cited by SAFE's own later Q&A.

title: Account and Service Tariff, Personal Customers (effective 1 January 2021)
quote: 6.1.2.1 发出电汇：电汇金额的0.1%，每笔最低人民币100元/等值，每笔最高人民币500元/等值，另加电报费。 6.1.2.2 电报费：每笔人民币120元/等值。 5.4.1.2 汇丰中国作为中转行：汇款金额的0.125%，每笔最低人民币200元，每笔最高人民币600元，另加电报费。 5.3.x 汇丰环球转账（向本人/家庭成员汇丰海外账户）免费。 7.2 电子银行人民币跨行付款单笔高于人民币500,000元：每笔人民币25元。
establishes: Published, itemised personal tariff: outgoing telegraphic transfer 0.1% of amount (floor CNY 100, cap CNY 500) plus CNY 120 cable; free inbound credit to an HSBC China account; 0.125% (CNY 200-600) if HSBC China acts as intermediary. HSBC Global Transfer to the customer's own HSBC overseas account is listed as free. This is a BANK's own published price, not a regulator's guarantee, and only one bank's schedule was verified.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
locator: Who must file; When to file
quote: A U.S. person, including a citizen... must file an FBAR to report: a financial interest in or signature or other authority over at least one financial account located outside the United States if the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported... The FBAR is an annual report, due April 15 following the calendar year reported. You're allowed an automatic extension to October 15.
establishes: A US citizen with a Chinese bank account exceeding USD 10,000 in aggregate at any time in the year must file FinCEN Form 114, due 15 April with an automatic extension to 15 October, filed separately from the tax return.

title: Do I need to file Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets?
quote: Unmarried taxpayers living in the US: The total value of your specified foreign financial assets is more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year or more than $75,000 at any time during the tax year... Taxpayers living abroad... unmarried: more than $200,000 on the last day of the tax year or more than $300,000 at any time during the year; joint return... more than $400,000 on the last day... or more than $600,000 at any time.
establishes: Form 8938 thresholds: USD 50,000 year-end / USD 75,000 any time for an unmarried taxpayer living in the US; USD 200,000 / 300,000 (single) or 400,000 / 600,000 (joint) for a taxpayer living abroad. Note the US-resident thresholds are already exceeded by a USD 100,000 balance.

title: Publication 514, Foreign Tax Credit for Individuals
locator: Choosing To Take Credit or Deduction; Carrybacks and carryovers
quote: As a general rule, you must choose each year to take either a credit or a deduction for all qualified foreign taxes paid or accrued in that year... There is a limit on the credit you can claim in a tax year. If your qualified foreign taxes exceed the credit limit, you may be able to carry over or carry back the excess to another tax year.
establishes: PRC income tax paid on the source income is creditable in the US, but only up to the limitation, and the credit/deduction choice is annual and applies to all foreign taxes. Excess may be carried back one year and forward ten.

title: Gifts from foreign person (Form 3520 Part IV reporting thresholds)
quote: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report the receipt of such gifts or bequests only if the aggregate amount received from that nonresident alien or foreign estate... exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year. If the gifts or bequests exceed $100,000, you must separately identify each gift in excess of $5,000... File Form 3520 separately from your income tax return.
establishes: Receiving more than USD 100,000 in the year as a gift from a nonresident individual triggers Form 3520 Part IV, filed separately. This threshold is verified here, resolving an open item in earlier material.

publisher: 26 U.S.C. (Cornell Legal Information Institute mirror of the U.S. Code)
title: 26 U.S.C. section 988 - Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
quote: (c)(1)(C)(i) In the case of any disposition of any nonfunctional currency - (I) such disposition shall be treated as a section 988 transaction... (e)(2) If (A) nonfunctional currency is disposed of by an individual in any transaction, and (B) such transaction is a personal transaction, no gain shall be recognized... by reason of changes in exchange rates... The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200. (e)(3) 'personal transaction' means any transaction entered into by an individual, except... to the extent that expenses properly allocable to such transaction meet the requirements of section 162... or section 212.
establishes: Converting a personal RMB deposit is a section 988 disposition, but for a personal transaction exchange gain up to USD 200 is not recognised; above USD 200 the gain is recognised as ordinary income at ordinary rates. A purely personal conversion therefore creates no US tax unless the RMB appreciated by more than USD 200 while held.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
quote: Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)... Anyone who brings, sends, or receives currency or monetary instruments totaling more than $10,000 at one time, either into or out of the United States, must report it... When families or groups are involved, the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual.
establishes: Any import or export of more than USD 10,000 in currency/monetary instruments must be reported on FinCEN Form 105, aggregated across a family or group. Failure risks seizure and civil or criminal penalties.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 - Penalty adjustment and table
locator: Table 1 (penalties assessed on or after 17 January 2025)
quote: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction - Non-Willful Violation of Transaction | $10,000 | $16,536 ... 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction - Willful Violation of Transaction | $100,000 | $165,353
establishes: Inflation-adjusted maxima: a non-willful FBAR violation is up to USD 16,536 per violation, and a willful one up to USD 165,353 per violation (penalties assessed on or after 17 January 2025). These are ceilings, not the expected amount.

title: 31 CFR 1010.350 - Reports of foreign financial accounts
quote: Reports of foreign financial accounts. (Authority: 12 U.S.C. 1829b and 1951-1959; 31 U.S.C. 5311-5314, 5316-5336 ...)
establishes: The regulatory basis for FBAR reporting of foreign financial accounts, including accounts in which a US person has a financial interest or signature authority.

title: United States - People's Republic of China Income Tax Convention (1984, with 1986 protocols)
quote: Art. 9(2) dividends... the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends. Art. 10(2) interest... shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest. Art. 11(2) royalties... shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties. Art. 12(1) Gains... from the alienation of real property... may be taxed in that other Contracting State. Art. 22(2) the United States shall allow... a credit against the United States tax on income: (a) the income tax paid to China.
establishes: Treaty ceilings of 10% on China-source dividends, interest and royalties for a US resident, China may tax gains on Chinese real property, and the treaty provides the mutual credit mechanism that underpins the Form 1116 claim.

publisher: China Foreign Exchange Trade System (CFETS), authorised by the PBOC
title: RMB central parity rate - USD/CNY (daily 09:15 publication)
quote: 美元/人民币 USD/CNY price 6.7188, lastDate 2026-11-09 9:15
establishes: The official PBoC-authorised central parity on 2026-11-09 is CNY 6.7188 per USD. This is a benchmark, NOT a customer rate; a customer rate differs by the bank's own spread, which no official source publishes (see S07). Captured as a dated snapshot and used only to convert CNY-denominated fee floors and caps.

title: Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
quote: You must express the amounts you report on your U.S. tax return in U.S. dollars... Make all income tax determinations in your functional currency. If your functional currency is the U.S. dollar, you must immediately translate into dollars all items of income, expense, etc. ... Use the exchange rate prevailing when you receive, pay, or accrue the item.
establishes: US reporting uses the spot rate at the transaction date; the IRS's own listed rate sources are the Treasury reporting rates and the Federal Reserve. No averaged rate may be substituted for a specific transaction.

title: Bank of China foreign exchange rate board (外汇牌价)
quote: 美元 现汇买入价 666.38 现钞买入价 666.38 现汇卖出价 669.19 现钞卖出价 669.19 中行折算价 671.88 发布日期 2026/11/09 发布时间 09:15:45 (units: CNY per 100 USD). The board states: 本汇率表单位为100外币换算人民币，仅供参考，客户办理结/购汇业务时，应以…实际交易汇率为准。
establishes: A dated, published retail quote from a major state bank. Bid 6.6638 and offer 6.6919 CNY per USD (per 100 units). The bid-offer spread is 0.42%, so the cost of one conversion measured against the bank's own mid is about 0.21%. The bank itself warns the executed rate may differ, so this is a benchmark for cost, not a guarantee of price.

title: China Merchants Bank live FX rates (外汇实时汇率)
quote: 美元 100 人民币 现汇卖出价 669.279 现钞卖出价 669.279 现汇买入价 666.375 现钞买入价 666.375 时间 09:34:38。以上资料仅供参考，以办理业务时的实时汇率为准。
establishes: A second independent state-bank quote on the same day: bid 6.66375, offer 6.69279 CNY per USD. Bid-offer spread 0.435%, one-way cost vs mid about 0.217%. Two banks agreeing within a few basis points supports a verified 0.21%-0.22% conversion-cost band for standard state-bank retail conversion.

publisher: 26 U.S.C. (Cornell LII mirror of the U.S. Code)
title: 26 U.S.C. section 6038D - Information with respect to foreign financial assets (Form 8938)
quote: (a) ... if the aggregate value of all such assets exceeds $50,000 ... (d)(1) If any individual fails to furnish the information ... such person shall pay a penalty of $10,000. (d)(2) If any failure ... continues for more than 90 days after the day on which the Secretary mails notice ... $10,000 for each 30-day period ... shall not exceed $50,000. (g) No penalty shall be imposed ... on any failure which is shown to be due to reasonable cause and not due to willful neglect.
establishes: The Form 8938 penalty is USD 10,000 per failure, rising by up to USD 50,000 more if it continues after IRS notice, with a reasonable-cause exception. It is a fixed statutory amount, not a percentage of the balance.

publisher: National People's Congress, via Guangdong Tax Service
title: Law of the PRC on the Administration of Tax Collection (2015 amendment)
quote: 第三十二条 纳税人未按照规定期限缴纳税款的…税务机关除责令限期缴纳外，从滞纳税款之日起，按日加收滞纳税款万分之五的滞纳金。 第四十四条 欠缴税款的纳税人…需要出境的，应当在出境前向税务机关结清应纳税款、滞纳金或者提供担保。未结清税款、滞纳金，又不提供担保的，税务机关可以通知出境管理机关阻止其出境。 第五十二条 因纳税人、扣缴义务人计算错误等失误，未缴或者少缴税款的，税务机关在三年内可以追征税款、滞纳金；有特殊情况的，追征期可以延长到五年。对偷税、抗税、骗税的…不受前款规定期限的限制。
establishes: Unpaid PRC tax accrues a late fee of 0.05% PER DAY (about 18.25% a year, uncompounded), the tax authority can block departure from China for a taxpayer who has not settled tax or provided security, and the lookback period is 3 years (5 in special cases), without limit for tax evasion. This is the mechanism that makes unpaid tax the largest real 'conversion penalty'.
